name: Lingua Robot
tagline: English dictionary and linguistic data API for words, definitions, and language analysis.
description: Lingua Robot is an English dictionary and linguistic data API that provides word definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, and related language information for developer applications. It targets education, writing tools, and language-learning products that need structured English lexical data via HTTP.

auth.details: API key via RapidAPI subscription headers (X-RapidAPI-Key and X-RapidAPI-Host); exact self-serve flow not independently verified in this pass.

example.response_snippet: {"entries":[{"entry":"hello","interpretations":[{"partOfSpeech":"interjection","definitions":[{"definition":"Used as a greeting or to begin a phone conversation."}]}],"pronunciations":[{"transcriptions":[{"transcription":"həˈləʊ","notation":"IPA"}]}]}]}

use_cases: look up English word definitions and parts of speech
fetch pronunciations and IPA transcriptions for a word
get synonyms and related word senses for writing tools
power dictionary lookup in language-learning apps
validate or enrich English vocabulary in educational products
